why: I checked all three must_catch items, and two are missed. Item 1 is missed: builder step 3 asks only for a `### clamp(x, lo, hi)` entry and says "Do not remove the existing add and multiply entries". It never says that subtract is exported but undocumented, or that it needs a README entry. Step 5 has the builder check that every exported name has a heading, but that is an indirect check, not an instruction to document subtract. Item 2 is missed: verifier Check 3 runs only `grep -n 'clamp(' README.md` and passes if clamp is documented. It never lists add, subtract, multiply and clamp, and it would not fail when subtract has no entry. Item 3 is met: Check 2 calls clamp with lo greater than hi and fails unless `e instanceof RangeError`.
